create_oneformer_config: create a OneFormerConfig instance with default settings for segmentation model initialization
create_oneformer_config_custom: create a OneFormerConfig instance with custom hyperparameters like hidden_dim and decoder_layers
create_oneformer_config_from_checkpoint: create a OneFormerConfig loaded from the shi-labs/oneformer_ade20k_swin_tiny pretrained checkpoint
create_oneformer_config_backbone: create a OneFormerConfig with a custom backbone configuration and swin transformer settings
create_oneformer_config_training: create a OneFormerConfig instance configured for training mode with auxiliary loss enabled
